### core-stays-generic

- Identity: ["project.markitect.example.org/v1alpha1","Statement","product","core-stays-generic"]

Core stays generic. It does not depend on Modules, Host, CLI, adopting repositories or model providers. A capability Module imports only Core and its own subtree.
